copy.headline: Il tuo gommista a Caserta
copy.tagline: Pneumatici in Via Gennaro Tescione a Caserta. Chiamaci allo 0823 302456.
copy.about:
Dell'Aquila Nicola Pneumatici è un negozio di pneumatici in Via Gennaro Tescione 35-37, a Caserta.

Chiamaci allo 0823 302456 o passa a trovarci.

business.name.note: Google listing name is 'Gommista Caserta “Dell'Aquila Nicola Pneumatici”' (lead row); the leading 'Gommista Caserta' is a keyword prefix and is dropped. Directories (PagineGialle, Virgilio) and VIES use the company name 'Dell'Aquila Nicola & C. S.n.c.'

business.legalName.note: VIES: 'DELL'AQUILA NICOLA E C. S.N.C.'; PagineGialle: 'Dell'Aquila Nicola & C. S.n.c.'

business.vatNumber.note: P.IVA from the PagineGialle listing (encoded in its 'Rivendica' link, not displayed); VIES returns isValid=true with the same company name, registered address Via Tescione n. 29, 81100 Caserta

business.address.note: House number conflict. 35-37: Google Maps (lead row) and Cylex (read from a search-result snippet only, page returns 403). 29: VIES registered address 'Via Tescione n. 29, 81100 Caserta'. PagineGialle and Virgilio (one Italiaonline database) give 'Via Tescione Gennaro, 81100 Caserta' with no number. No majority (registry counts double); 35-37 kept as the shop entrance shown on Maps, the registry 29 may be the registered seat. Street name 'Via Gennaro Tescione', CAP 81100 and Caserta confirmed by OpenStreetMap

business.phone.note: Google Maps (lead row) and PagineGialle/Virgilio (one Italiaonline database) agree

business.googleMapsUrl.note: Search link from the lead row (batch 2026-10-30-campania_leads, id 007), not a place link

business.rating.note: 4.7 from 251 reviews, from the lead row

business.geo.note: Street-level match (Via Gennaro Tescione, Caserta, Aldifreda, San Leucio, Caserta, Campania, 81100, Italia): OpenStreetMap has no house number 35-37 here.
